dedupe_keys.name: building stock and building typology of kigali rwanda

description: This dataset maps the building stock of central Kigali, Rwanda, with footprints, heights and a classification into nine building archetypes, for two dates. It was produced by Felix Bachofer and Pablo d'Angelo of the German Aerospace Center, Andreas Braun and Florian Adamietz of the University of Tübingen, with the International Growth Centre, Rwanda's Ministry of Infrastructure and the City of Kigali, to inform housing, infrastructure planning, municipal revenue and service supply in a fast-growing city. Buildings for 2015 were derived from a Pléiades satellite image of August 2015 by object-based image analysis and expert post-classification, and compared with footprints from 2008-2009 aerial images: 165,625 built entities in 2008-2009 and 211,458 in 2015, a rise of 27.7 per cent. Coverage is the central part of Kigali. Access: one zip file of 23 MB on Zenodo, published 5 June 2019, described in a Data journal article. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: a revised version of the data behind a 2018 housing report; the stock has changed since 2015. Simulation uses are building exposure for flood and earthquake risk, housing supply analysis and urban growth scenarios. Related records: GlobalBuildingAtlas and the HOT OpenStreetMap exports.
